title: Properties of the strict w-local cover
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, and let $C_A$ be the strict w-local cover algebra of [def-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover]. The map $A\to C_A$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] and ind-etale [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. Its spectrum is w-local [def-weil-pbc-w-local], its local rings at maximal ideals are strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], and the induced map from its closed points onto $\operatorname{Spec}A$ is surjective.

proof.text: Put $W=A^w$, $E=W^{\mathrm e}$, $T=V(IE)$, and $C_A=E_{[T]}$, as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover]. By [lem-weil-pbc-w-localization-points], the closed points of $\operatorname{Spec}W$ form the closed subset $V(I)$ and map onto $\operatorname{Spec}A$: the point $(x,x)$ maps to $x$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-contraction], $W\to E$ is faithfully flat and ind-etale and every maximal localization $E_q$ is strictly henselian.

For q in T, its contraction m to W contains I; the closedness of the closed-point locus, together with zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure, therefore makes m maximal. Give E/q its canonical W/m-algebra structure and map it injectively to its fraction field q.ResidueField. The already-proved source-library theorem Algebra.IndEtale.isSeparable_of_algHom_to_isLocalRing (WeilConjectures.RingTheory.ProEtale.IndEtale) makes every image of an element of E separable over W/m. These images are integral; isIntegral_algHom_iff reflects integrality along the injective fraction-field map. The quotient E/q is a domain integral over a field, so isField_of_isIntegral_of_isField' makes it a field. Thus q is maximal. This argument is the fully proved private helper maximal_of_indEtale; it needs neither ind-etale base change nor the weakly-etale field theorem.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-retained-localization] to T=V(IE), which consists of closed points by step 2. It supplies w-locality, an equivalence of primes with retained pairs, a homeomorphism from T to closed points, and bijective canonical local-ring maps. For a maximal ideal of C_A, invert the closed-point homeomorphism: its retained pair is (q,q). The local ring E_q is strictly henselian by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-contraction]. RingEquiv.ofBijective turns the supplied canonical local-ring bijection into a ring equivalence; the already-proved IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing.of_ringEquiv in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.RingTheory.Henselian transfers strict henselianity. The use of the homeomorphism remembers its explicitly induced patch topology.

For every $x\in\operatorname{Spec}A$, step 1 supplies a closed point $m$ of $\operatorname{Spec}W$ over $x$. Since $W\to E$ is faithfully flat, [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-surjective-spectrum] supplies a prime $q$ of $E$ contracting to $m$. The inclusion $I\subseteq m$ implies $IE\subseteq q$, so $q\in T$. Step 3 identifies $q$ with a closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}C_A$, whose image in $\operatorname{Spec}E$ is $q$ by the canonical pair description of [lem-weil-pbc-retained-localization]. Its image in $\operatorname{Spec}A$ is therefore $x$. This proves the claimed closed-point surjectivity.

The fully proved private helper indEtale_of_principal converts a principal ind-Zariski presentation into an ind-etale one: each finite product of principal localizations is etale by Mathlib instances, and Algebra.Etale.of_equiv transfers this to each stage. Apply this to [def-weil-pbc-w-localization] and to the retained structural map from [lem-weil-pbc-retained-localization]. Compose these maps with the ind-etale contraction by the source library's proved RingHom.IndEtale.comp. Algebra.IndEtale.weaklyEtale (WeilConjectures.RingTheory.ProEtale.IndWeaklyEtale) makes the resulting algebra flat. Step 4 implies spectrum surjectivity, and [lem-weil-pbc-flat-surjective-spectrum-faithfully-flat] then gives faithful flatness.
